title: jmap-object-uri: jmap: URI parser and formatter
description: Implement draft-atwood-jmap-object-uri-00: parse, validate and format jmap: object URIs, and resolve them against a Session. The chat forward rule (jmap-chat-spec a21a37c) and the other drafts already reference this scheme. The name was claimed on crates.io 2026-10-30 as an early 0.0.1 release from ~/PROJECT/jmap-name-claims/ (outside this workspace). Done when: the crate lives in this workspace as a member (Cargo.toml members + [workspace.dependencies] entry once something depends on it), follows the canonical-template rule, has tests with independent oracles, a public-api/ snapshot, a RELEASING.md layer entry, and publishes on the shared jmap-* version line (replacing 0.0.1).
